main.description: Prefix completion over the catalog for a search field. Every whitespace-separated term must prefix-match the edition title, subtitle, or a contributor name; results are ranked by the catalog index and hydrated to full edition views. Anonymous; no session or scope is required.

q.description: Text typed so far. At least two characters; each whitespace-separated term is matched as a prefix.

limit.description: Maximum number of editions to return.

items.description: Editions whose title, subtitle or contributors complete the typed terms, best match first.
